newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan high-tech shares rise after Wall St rally.
newsitem.headline: Japan high-tech shares rise after Wall St rally.

text.p: Shares of Japanese high-technology companies, particularly semiconductor-related issues, rose on Wednesday morning, helped by Wall Street's record-setting run, traders said.

At 0105 GMT, shares of Tokyo Electron Ltd, which makes semiconductor manufacturing equipment, were up 90 yen at 6,910 yen. Advantest Corp, which makes semiconductor testing devices, was up 110 yen at 9,930 yen.

"Following Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's speech on a brighter outlook for the U.S. economy and a sharp rise in U.S. stocks, blue-chip issues in Tokyo resumed their rise," said a broker at a second-tier Japanese securities house.
